owner_goal: 建立三間汽車保養維修廠營運 ChatGPT App：先診斷等待過久的根因，再管理預約、接車、工單、技師技能、工位、零件等待、報價核准、進度通知與完工交車。不得在未驗證根因前只做排班系統。需要前後端網站、管理後台、工具、技能、測試與 ZIP。

project_variables.rule: Project variables may change by industry; they must not weaken the fixed core guards.

payload_policy.large_dataset_rule: Never send the full dataset to the Widget; send one bounded page plus total_count and next_cursor.

required_data_contracts.guard: confirmation and backend result required for writes/transactions

domain_adapter_contract.input: industry-specific project data from the customer-owned backend

result_delivery.updates: listen for ui/notifications/tool-result over MCP Apps postMessage
result_delivery.fallback: keep tool text useful when UI is unavailable

video_policy.direct_media: HTTPS MP4/WebM or browser-supported HLS in a controls + playsinline video element
video_policy.third_party: open an external project-owned page by default; iframe only for explicitly allowlisted frameDomains

action_policy.navigation: feature-detect window.openai.openExternal, otherwise use a normal HTTPS link
action_policy.read: call an allowlisted read tool when the host supports it
action_policy.write_transaction: require explicit confirmation and backend tool result; a UI click never proves success or grants entitlement

quota_upgrade_policy.render_rule: Show the quota/payment notice first, then render project-owned plan cards and a pricing_url action when provided.
quota_upgrade_policy.data_source: Use the project plan/product manifest for product_code, price, quota, expiry and checkout state; never copy another product's brand, pricing or entitlement rules.
quota_upgrade_policy.entitlement_truth: Only verified backend entitlement state can unlock usage. A visible plan card or pricing link is guidance, not access proof.

versioning: Create a new immutable resource URI for incompatible UI changes and retain prior versions for rollback.
truth_boundary: Generated schema, renderer runtime, MCP Apps resource contract, and local validation proof only; not deployed frontend, remote MCP, ChatGPT native rendering, payment, submission, or OpenAI approval proof
